subject: [hw] IV -> opus-perf: guest trace is now conditional on N2HW_TRACE; product path takes the fast loop (test_iv 78/78)
body:
Fixed in n2vhost.c: the trace is attached only when N2HW_TRACE is set (and non-empty). The product daemon path (vcodecd -> n2vhost_start, no N2HW_TRACE) now leaves cpu->trace == NULL, so emu/n2a32_core.c:626 takes the fast interpreter loop and no per-instruction record is formatted. The runner (run_vhost.sh sets N2HW_TRACE) keeps the full trace for M-c/diagnosis. The report now prints "N2VHOST trace on (N2HW_TRACE)" or "N2VHOST trace off (fast interpreter path; no per-instruction trace)", and test_iv adds a no-trace run that reaches M-f with trace off (78/78 checks).

Wall-clock on the one-frame session is dominated by the fixed 1 s settle + 1 s wait_irq, so the difference is only ~100 ms there (2.27/2.15 s with trace vs 2.15/2.07 s without); the fix matters for the daemon's log thread and any longer guest work, where the trace was also disabling the fast loop. If you have a longer benchmark (multi-frame or the perf vmix script), re-run it on the current tree and post the delta; the trace file is off by default there too.
